purpose: Train-only phage protein representation capacity and resource pilot; no host infection model or target outcome evaluation
software_deviation: MMseqs18 rather than the paper-listed15.6f452; explicit methodological adaptation, with effective parameter logs retained.
normalization: Remove exactly one terminal stop, retain copies/internal sequences/X residues; assign globally unique neutral protein IDs. No target protein enters the training database or occurrence consolidation.
createdb_input: Sorted deterministic concatenated protein FASTA supplied as stdin, matching upstream createdb stdin semantics

resources.rss_scope: Cumulative maximum RSS of serial direct child processes, not aggregate workflow memory

interpretation: Distinct vectors only establish potential representational capacity, not strain specificity or accuracy. Equal phage vectors preclude distinguishing phage-dependent responses within this feature scheme but do not alone rule out a host-only T3 ranking. No infection score, assembly score, design or DNA export is generated.

mapping_control.interpretation: Mapping control only; not specificity validation

replay_provenance.refinement: Reject internal/double-terminal stops; strengthen source/command/raw replay authentication; no parameter or numeric retuning
